roadmap.title: Candlekeep and early adventures
roadmap.description: Plan two base-game campaigns: one entirely on Story Mode and one entirely on Legacy of Bhaal. Combine the solo challenge with one run and never recruit companions on that run. On the party run, finish Candlekeep tasks before leaving and keep separate saves before quest choices.

roadmap.title: Nashkel, bandits and Cloakwood
roadmap.description: Follow the iron crisis through Nashkel, the bandit camp and Cloakwood. Complete nearby side quests before moving on.

roadmap.title: Baldur's Gate and the campaign finale
roadmap.description: Complete city quests, Durlag's Tower and the campaign. Keep a save before the final battle for alternate party outcomes.

roadmap.title: Siege of Dragonspear: chapters 7–9
roadmap.description:
Before A Long Journey leaves Baldur’s Gate, start My Missing Fortune with Ophyllis in the Ducal Palace basement, recruit Viconia outside the palace, and get the Spectacles of Spectacle from Zaviak in the Elfsong Tavern. Reserve their three charges for Nazramu, Vidyadhar and Zhadroth. Save before arriving at Coast Way Crossing with a singer below 16 Charisma; keep that singer in the party through the first conversation with Prin.

Finish the Chapter 8 tasks before leaving Coast Way Crossing. Recruit Baeloth and M’Khiin there for the later party achievements. For Explorer, travel from Coast Way Forest back to Coast Way Crossing before leaving Chapter 8. For Riddlemaster, reload after Painful Recital and answer the menhir riddle with ‘The wind blowing in a tree next to a river.’

In Chapter 9, trigger Explorer’s goblin ambush by travelling from Troll Claw Woods to Forest of Wyrms, then leave Forest of Wyrms for the green dragon and hill giants. Keep each chapter’s save. Before resolving Bridgefort’s siege, speak to Neera, collect her Giant Spider Leg and Planetar Feather, and meet Hoach Randymonk with Glint. Save before the siege; keep peaceful surrender as the continuing outcome so Delgar Munsch survives for All the Enemies. For the later trial, tell Madele to make amends.

roadmap.title: Siege of Dragonspear: chapter 10
roadmap.description:
Finish Chapter 10 preparations before Hasty Retreat closes the Underground River route. At the Coalition Camp, meet Pritchard with Glint before the Damius and Sempek task makes Pritchard leave. Complete Explorer’s canyon encounter and finish Neera’s remaining ingredients. For Riddlemaster, answer Vidyadhar’s riddle with ‘Bees’ when Far Out summons him.

For All the Allies, win Murs’s challenge alone without magic, rescue Slug from the Warrens cage, then report back to Murs and request the ogres’ help before returning to camp for the defense. For All the Enemies, leave Strunk’s elementals alone and keep Strunk alive during the escape.

Prepare at least three trial defenses before the final chapters: Madele’s amends, unpoisoned crusader supplies, curing Dosia’s patients, high reputation, or being a paladin. For Dosia’s defense, bring Strange Tree bark from Bloodbark Grove to her at the Coalition Camp before leaving Chapter 10. Reload after Blessed By Talona so the continuing save keeps the supplies unpoisoned. Retain separate saves before Hasty Retreat and the camp attack.

roadmap.title: Siege of Dragonspear: chapters 11–13
roadmap.description: Keep an assault save for the ally, enemy and duel outcomes. Complete the Chapter 11 castle tasks before continuing to Avernus. At Thrix’s wager, save and use your own soul with the answer ‘Murder’ to preserve your trial defense; reload after You Chose... Poorly. Resolve the portal outcomes and retain the Chapter 13 autosave for the alternate trial and sewer outcomes.

roadmap.title: Difficulty, solo and character challenges
roadmap.description: Use separate campaign runs for Story Mode and Legacy of Bhaal. Plan a solo run and finish remaining character-stat challenges.

achievements.description: Become a Grand Master.
achievements.summary: Give your main character five proficiency points in one weapon.

steps.text: Start @loc{The Black Pits} with a single-class @mechanic{Fighter} as your main character. Put weapon proficiency points into the same weapon as you create and level the character.
Reach level 9 and spend the fifth point in that weapon. Replay completed arena fights if you need more experience.

achievements.description: Complete the game solo.
achievements.summary: Finish the Baldur's Gate campaign without ever adding another character to your party.

steps.text: Begin a campaign with only your main character. After Gorion dies, run south toward @loc{High Hedge} before @npc{Imoen} can speak to you and join.
Decline every companion for the entire campaign and defeat @enemy{Sarevok}. Do not create extra party members.

achievements.description: Complete the game on Legacy of Bhaal difficulty.
achievements.summary: Finish the Baldur's Gate campaign entirely on Legacy of Bhaal difficulty.

steps.text: Choose @mechanic{Legacy of Bhaal} when starting the campaign and keep that difficulty throughout the run.
Complete the main story and defeat @enemy{Sarevok}.

achievements.description: Complete the game on Story Mode difficulty.
achievements.summary: Finish the Baldur's Gate campaign entirely on Story Mode difficulty.

steps.text: Start a new campaign on @mechanic{Story Mode} and leave that setting enabled until @enemy{Sarevok} is defeated.

achievements.description: Increase an attribute score to 25.
achievements.summary: Raise one of your main character's attributes to 25.

steps.text: Save before changing difficulty or drinking a potion. Outside @mechanic{Story Mode}, buy a @item{Red Potion} or @item{Violet Potion} from the potions tent at @loc{Nashkel Carnival} and have your main character drink it.
Reload your save after the achievement if you want to undo the potion's drawbacks. Keep this attempt separate from an uninterrupted Story Mode run.

achievements.description: Have an Armor Class of -15 or lower.
achievements.summary: Lower your main character's Armor Class to -15 or less.

steps.text: Use a main character with Dexterity 18 or higher who can equip a shield and helmet. Buy @item{The Claw of Kazgaroth} from @npc{Thalantyr} at @loc{High Hedge}.

In @loc{Baldur's Gate}, collect @item{Guard's Ring} in @loc{Ramazith's Tower}, @item{Helm of Balduran} from the trapped wall container upstairs in the @loc{Helm and Cloak Inn}, and @item{Cloak of Balduran} by pickpocketing @npc{Quenash} in the @loc{Undercellar}.

Equip those four items and a @item{Large Shield +1}. Buy @item{Potion of Defense} and enough @item{Potions of Mind Focusing} at @loc{Sorcerous Sundries} to raise Dexterity to 25; their Dexterity bonuses stack.
Drink the potions and have a priest cast @mechanic{Defensive Harmony} on your main character. Check that the character sheet shows Armor Class -15 or lower.

achievements.description: Finish the game without any party members dying.
achievements.summary: Finish the Baldur's Gate campaign without any recruited companion dying.

steps.text: Play on @mechanic{Story Mode}, which protects your party from death, and keep every recruited companion alive through the final battle with @enemy{Sarevok}.

achievements.description: Finish the game with a full party of dead allies.
achievements.summary: Defeat Sarevok with all five companions in your full party dead.

steps.text: Bring five companions into the final battle and keep a save from before the fight. Use a difficulty other than @mechanic{Story Mode}.
Let all five companions die, then finish @enemy{Sarevok} with your main character. Do not switch to Story Mode, which resurrects dead companions.
Reload the pre-battle save afterward if you want to finish with your party alive.

achievements.description: Reach 150 Hit Points.
achievements.summary: Raise your main character's maximum Hit Points to at least 150.

steps.text: Create a @mechanic{Half-orc Fighter} main character with Constitution 19 in @loc{The Black Pits}. Level the character through arena fights; replay completed fights for more experience.
Buy @item{Potion of Heroism} and @item{Potion of Power} from @npc{Bellowgulp}. Drink Heroism first, then Power, and check that your maximum Hit Points reach 150.

achievements.description: Acquire Heroic reputation.
achievements.summary: Reach a party reputation of at least 17.

steps.text: Resolve side quests in favor of the people asking for help until party reputation reaches @mechanic{Heroic} at 17 or higher.

achievements.description: Acquire Despised reputation.
achievements.summary: Lower party reputation to 4 or less.

steps.text: Save your game, then kill civilians until reputation becomes @mechanic{Despised} at 4 or less. Reload that save afterward to restore your earlier reputation.

achievements.description: Kill 1,000 creatures.
achievements.summary: Kill 1,000 creatures.

steps.text: Keep fighting while completing the campaign and side quests. If you still need kills afterward, rest or travel around @loc{Gnoll Stronghold} and defeat the creatures that ambush your party.

achievements.description: Have a Lore skill of 100 or more.
achievements.summary: Raise your main character's Lore to at least 100.

steps.text: Use a @mechanic{Bard} main character in @loc{The Black Pits} and raise Intelligence and Wisdom during character creation.
Replay arena fights to gain levels until the character sheet shows at least @mechanic{100 Lore}. Bards gain 10 Lore per level, so level 10 supplies 100 before positive attribute bonuses.

achievements.description: Become a Fallen Paladin or a Fallen Ranger.
achievements.summary: Turn your Paladin or Ranger main character into a Fallen Paladin or Fallen Ranger.

steps.text: Start with a @mechanic{Paladin} or @mechanic{Ranger} main character. Save, then kill civilians until reputation falls to 5 or below and the character becomes Fallen.
Reload the save afterward if you want to restore the character's class abilities and reputation.

achievements.description: Have Bless, Chant, and Luck active at the same time.
achievements.summary: Give your main character the Bless, Chant, and Luck effects simultaneously.

steps.text: Have a priest cast @mechanic{Bless} and @mechanic{Chant} so they affect your main character. Have a mage cast @mechanic{Luck} on that same character before the other effects expire.

achievements.description: Have Disease, Fatigue, and Poison active at the same time.
achievements.summary: Give your main character Disease, Fatigue, and Poison simultaneously.

steps.text: Save first and use a difficulty other than @mechanic{Story Mode}. Travel repeatedly without resting until your main character has @mechanic{Fatigue}.

Have a level 7 priest cast @mechanic{Poison} and a level 7 mage cast @mechanic{Contagion} on your main character so Poison and Disease overlap with Fatigue. @loc{Sorcerous Sundries} sells a Contagion scroll.
Reload and try again if your main character resists a spell. After unlocking the achievement, reload your clean save.

achievements.description: Finish the Candlekeep prologue.
achievements.summary: Finish the Candlekeep prologue.

steps.text: Speak to @npc{Gorion} in @loc{Candlekeep} when you are ready to leave and play through the departure.

achievements.displayName: Friendly Faces at the Friendly Arm
achievements.description: Meet Khalid and Jaheira inside the Friendly Arm Inn.
achievements.summary: Meet Khalid and Jaheira inside the Friendly Arm Inn.

steps.text: Before finishing @loc{Nashkel Mines}, visit @loc{Friendly Arm Inn} and speak with @npc{Khalid} and @npc{Jaheira}. Recruiting them is unnecessary.
Keep a save from before the end of Nashkel Mines; if you finish the mines without meeting them and they disappear, reload that save.

achievements.description: Defeat Mulahey and uncover his correspondence in Nashkel Mines.
achievements.summary: Defeat Mulahey and uncover his correspondence in Nashkel Mines.

steps.text: Reach @enemy{Mulahey} on level 4 of @loc{Nashkel Mines}, defeat him, and collect the letters that expose the mine plot to finish Chapter 2.

achievements.description: Expose the bandit operation by taking the letters from Tazok's tent.
achievements.summary: Expose the bandit operation by taking the letters from Tazok's tent.

steps.text: Follow the main story to the @loc{Bandit Camp}. Clear the enemies in @loc{Tazok's tent} and take the letters from the chest to finish Chapter 3.

achievements.description: Defeat Davaeorn and end the Cloakwood mining operation.
achievements.summary: Defeat Davaeorn and end the Cloakwood mining operation.

steps.text: Fight through @loc{Cloakwood Mines} and kill @enemy{Davaeorn} to finish Chapter 4. Take his key and return to the first level to arrange the mine's flooding.

achievements.description: Report the Iron Throne plot to Duke Eltan and accept the journey to Candlekeep.
achievements.summary: Report the Iron Throne plot to Duke Eltan and accept the journey to Candlekeep.

steps.text: Search the top floor of the @loc{Iron Throne tower} for the chest containing letters. Present the letters to @npc{Duke Eltan} and accept his proposal to visit @loc{Candlekeep}.

achievements.description: Escape through the catacombs beneath Candlekeep.
achievements.summary: Escape through the catacombs beneath Candlekeep.

steps.text: Continue the Chapter 6 story in @loc{Candlekeep} and leave through the underground catacombs.

achievements.description: Defeat Sarevok at the end of the Baldur's Gate campaign.
achievements.summary: Defeat Sarevok at the end of the Baldur's Gate campaign.

steps.text: Follow the Chapter 7 main story to its final confrontation and kill @enemy{Sarevok}.

achievements.description: Kill Silke's targets and receive her reward in Beregost.
achievements.summary: Kill Silke's targets and receive her reward in Beregost.

steps.text: Accept @npc{Garrick}'s job in @loc{Beregost} and follow him to @npc{Silke}. Save before deciding what to do with the men she identifies.
Agree to Silke's request, kill the men, and speak with Silke for your reward. Reload the decision save to take the opposing route.

achievements.description: Defeat Silke after refusing to kill her targets in Beregost.
achievements.summary: Defeat Silke after refusing to kill her targets in Beregost.

steps.text: Accept @npc{Garrick}'s job in @loc{Beregost} and follow him to @npc{Silke}. Save before deciding whether to attack the men.
Refuse Silke's demand to kill the men, then defeat her when she attacks. Reload the decision save to take Silke's side instead.

achievements.description: Confront Jenkal about helping kobolds enter Gullykin.
achievements.summary: Confront Jenkal about helping kobolds enter Gullykin.

steps.text: Enter @npc{Jenkal}'s home, the westernmost round house in @loc{Gullykin}. Go downstairs, speak with Jenkal, and accuse him of smelling of kobolds.

achievements.description: Return Drienne's dead cat to her at Dryad Falls.
achievements.summary: Return Drienne's dead cat to her at Dryad Falls.

steps.text: Pick up the dead cat at the foot of the waterfall in @loc{Dryad Falls}. Give the cat to @npc{Drienne}, who is standing above the waterfall.

achievements.description: Restore Tamah from petrification.
achievements.summary: Restore Tamah from petrification.

steps.text: Take a @item{Stone to Flesh} scroll to the basilisk wilderness north of @loc{Gullykin}. Use the scroll on @npc{Tamah}, the interactable statue in the northwestern part of the area.

achievements.description: Return Joseph's greenstone ring to his wife in Nashkel.
achievements.summary: Give Joseph’s greenstone ring back to his wife.

steps.text: Pick up @item{Joseph's greenstone ring} from the floor near the entrance to level 3 of @loc{Nashkel Mines}. Give the ring to Joseph's wife in the westernmost house in @loc{Nashkel}.

achievements.description: Keep Hulrik's cow alive through the xvart attack.
achievements.summary: Keep Hulrik's cow alive through the xvart attack.

steps.text: Save before approaching @npc{Hulrik} and his cow in the southern part of @loc{Lonely Peaks}, south of @loc{Ulcaster}. Kill the attacking @enemy{xvarts} quickly, then speak with Hulrik.
If the cow dies, reload the approach save and stop the attackers sooner.

achievements.description: Help Seniyad defeat Aldeth and his companions in Cloakwood.
achievements.summary: Help Seniyad defeat Aldeth and his companions in Cloakwood.

steps.text: Save before speaking with @npc{Aldeth Sashenstar} near the lodge in the first @loc{Cloakwood} area.
Side with @npc{Seniyad} and kill Aldeth, @enemy{Palin}, and @enemy{Balquo}, even if the latter two remain neutral. Speak with Seniyad afterward.
Reload the decision save to unlock the opposing outcome.

achievements.description: Help Aldeth defeat Seniyad and his druids in Cloakwood.
achievements.summary: Help Aldeth defeat Seniyad and his druids in Cloakwood.

steps.text: Save before speaking with @npc{Aldeth Sashenstar} near the lodge in the first @loc{Cloakwood} area.
Side with @npc{Aldeth Sashenstar} and kill @enemy{Seniyad} and his druids. Speak with Aldeth afterward.
Reload the decision save to unlock the opposing outcome.

achievements.description: Defeat the Demon Knight at the bottom of Durlag's Tower.
achievements.summary: Defeat the Demon Knight at the bottom of Durlag's Tower.

steps.text: Explore the underground dungeon beneath @loc{Durlag's Tower} and defeat the @enemy{Demon Knight} in the final level.

achievements.description: Return Ulcaster's missing tome to his ghost.
achievements.summary: Return Ulcaster's missing tome to his ghost.

steps.text: Speak repeatedly with @npc{Ulcaster's ghost} around the northeastern hilltop ruins at @loc{Ulcaster} until he asks for a book.
Find the book inside @loc{Ulcaster Dungeon} and give the book to the ghost. If the ghost is absent, rest near the dungeon entrance and look again.

achievements.description: Take the idol from the archaeological tomb and defeat the Doomsayer.
achievements.summary: Take the idol from the archaeological tomb and defeat the Doomsayer.

steps.text: At the dig site southeast of the @loc{Lighthouse}, help @npc{Charlston Nib} enter the tomb. Loot the sarcophagus for the @item{Idol}, then save before leaving.
Defeat the @enemy{Doomsayer} outside while keeping the idol. Use enchanted weapons; ordinary weapons cannot hurt the creature.

achievements.description: Complete Charlston Nib's work at the archaeological dig.
achievements.summary: Complete Charlston Nib's work at the archaeological dig.

steps.text: At the dig site southeast of the @loc{Lighthouse}, save before accepting the work. Agree to help @npc{Charlston Nib}, then refuse @npc{Gallor}'s plan to murder him.
Enter the tomb, defeat the attackers, and speak with Charlston. Reload the earlier save to pursue Gallor's outcome.

achievements.description: Kill Charlston Nib and deliver the archaeological idol to Gallor.
achievements.summary: Kill Charlston Nib and deliver the archaeological idol to Gallor.

steps.text: Save before accepting work at the archaeological dig southeast of the @loc{Lighthouse}. Agree to help @npc{Charlston Nib}, then accept @npc{Gallor}'s plan.
Enter the tomb, kill Charlston, and take the @item{Idol} from the sarcophagus. Return outside and speak with Gallor. Reload your decision save to protect Charlston instead.

achievements.description: Kill Tenya and collect the fishermen's reward.
achievements.summary: Kill Tenya and collect the fishermen's reward.

steps.text: Accept @npc{Sonner}'s request in the @loc{Fishing Village} north of the Friendly Arm Inn. Find @npc{Tenya} northeast of @loc{Wyrm's Crossing} and fight until she stops to explain the stolen bowl.
Agree to help Tenya and finish the conversation, then save. Kill Tenya and return to Sonner for payment.
Reload the decision save to complete the opposing branch.

achievements.description: Return the stolen bowl to Tenya.
achievements.summary: Return the stolen bowl to Tenya.

steps.text: Accept @npc{Sonner}'s request in the @loc{Fishing Village} north of the Friendly Arm Inn. Find @npc{Tenya} northeast of @loc{Wyrm's Crossing} and fight until she stops to explain the stolen bowl.
Agree to help Tenya and finish the conversation, then save. Confront Sonner for the stolen bowl and return the bowl to Tenya.
Reload the decision save to complete the opposing branch.

achievements.description: Persuade Captain Brage to seek refuge at Helm's temple.
achievements.summary: Persuade Captain Brage to seek refuge at Helm's temple.

steps.text: Speak with @npc{Nalin} in @loc{Nashkel}'s Temple of Helm first. Save before approaching @npc{Captain Brage} near the middle of the @loc{Archaeological Site}.
Promise @npc{Laryssa} that you will spare Brage if she speaks to you. Answer Brage's riddle with @mechanic{death} and agree to spare him and return to the temple.
Reload the approach save to take Brage's lethal outcome.

achievements.description: Kill Captain Brage.
achievements.summary: Kill Captain Brage.

steps.text: Save before approaching @npc{Captain Brage} near the middle of the @loc{Archaeological Site}. Tell @npc{Laryssa} or Brage that you intend to kill him, then defeat him.
Reload the approach save to spare Brage instead.

achievements.description: Protect Prism until he finishes his sculpture.
achievements.summary: Protect Prism until he finishes his sculpture.

steps.text: Save before speaking with @npc{Prism} outside @loc{Nashkel Mines}. Agree to protect him, refuse @enemy{Greywolf}'s demand, and defeat Greywolf.
Let Prism finish and speak with you. If Prism is killed before finishing, reload the approach save.

achievements.description: Return Prism’s stolen emeralds to Oublek.
achievements.summary: Return Prism’s stolen emeralds to Oublek.

steps.text: Find @npc{Prism} outside the Nashkel Mines. After resolving his encounter, take the emeralds from his sculpture.
Give the emeralds to @npc{Oublek} in Nashkel.

achievements.description: Free Abela the nymph from captivity.
achievements.summary: Free Abela the nymph from captivity.

steps.text: Save before entering Ragefast’s house; reload if Abela is sent to Ramazith instead of freed.
Enter @loc{Ragefast’s house} in western Baldur’s Gate. Kill Ragefast and release @npc{Abela}.

achievements.description: Return Casson’s body to his father Tremain.
achievements.summary: Return Casson’s body to his father Tremain.

steps.text: Speak to @npc{Varci Roaringhorn} in northwest western Baldur’s Gate. Follow him and agree to help Tremain.
At the @loc{Temple of Umberlee} in southern Baldur’s Gate, ask a priestess to speak with Tenya and request Casson’s body.
Bring the body back to @npc{Tremain}.

achievements.description: Steal the telescope from the Hall of Wonders.
achievements.summary: Steal the telescope from the Hall of Wonders.

steps.text: Save inside the @loc{Hall of Wonders} in western Baldur’s Gate. Unlock the cylindrical display case near the entrance and take the telescope. Reload afterward if the guards catch you.

achievements.description: Persuade Marl to end his confrontation peacefully.
achievements.summary: Persuade Marl to end his confrontation peacefully.

steps.text: Save before speaking to @npc{Marl} in Feldepost’s Inn in Beregost. Answer in this sequence: @mechanic{1, 1, 3, 3, 1}. Reload this save to take the violent outcome as well.

achievements.description: Kill Marl after provoking his attack.
achievements.summary: Kill Marl after provoking his attack.

steps.text: Save before speaking to @npc{Marl} in Feldepost’s Inn in Beregost. Threaten Marl and kill him when he attacks. Reload this save to resolve the confrontation peacefully as well.

achievements.description: Complete all six Candlekeep chores during the prologue.
achievements.summary: Complete all six Candlekeep chores during the prologue.

steps.text: Before leaving with Gorion, finish these six errands. Keep a save before leaving Candlekeep so you can return to unfinished chores.
Return Phyldia’s book from behind Dreppin’s cow. Speak to Firebead in the inn, ask Tethtoril in the central grounds for the scroll, then deliver the scroll to Firebead.

Buy crossbow bolts at the inn and deliver them to Fuller. Take Hull’s sword and the antidote from the upper-right chest inside Fuller’s building. Return the sword to Hull at the gate and the antidote to Dreppin.
Speak to Reevor beside the storehouse above the Temple of Oghma. Kill the rats inside and report back.

achievements.description: Give Firebead Elvenhair the History of the Fateful Coin.
achievements.summary: Give Firebead Elvenhair the History of the Fateful Coin.

steps.text: Speak to @npc{Firebead Elvenhair} in the Beregost house opposite Feldepost’s Inn. Buy @item{History of the Fateful Coin} at the inn and bring the book to him.

achievements.description: Kill both Carbos and Shank during the prologue.
achievements.summary: Kill both Carbos and Shank during the prologue.

steps.text: Before leaving Candlekeep with Gorion, save and defeat the Bunkhouse assassin @enemy{Carbos} and the Priest’s Quarter assassin @enemy{Shank}. Reload the save if you leave before killing both.

achievements.description: Kill Dynaheir for Edwin.
achievements.summary: Kill Dynaheir for Edwin.

steps.text: Recruit @npc{Edwin} in Nashkel and travel to @loc{Gnoll Stronghold}. Save before approaching Dynaheir.
Kill @npc{Dynaheir} to finish Edwin’s request. Reload the save to free her as well.

achievements.description: Rescue Dynaheir from the Gnoll Stronghold.
achievements.summary: Rescue Dynaheir from the Gnoll Stronghold.

steps.text: At @loc{Gnoll Stronghold}, save before approaching @npc{Dynaheir}, then free her and accept her into your party. Reload this save if you kill her for Edwin instead.

achievements.description: Restore Branwen to life at the Nashkel Carnival.
achievements.summary: Restore Branwen to life at the Nashkel Carnival.

steps.text: Buy a @item{Stone to Flesh} scroll at Nashkel’s Temple of Helm or from Zeke beside the carnival statue. Use the scroll on @npc{Branwen’s statue}.

achievements.description: Have Neera, Dorn, and Rasaad in the party at the same time.
achievements.summary: Keep Neera, Dorn and Rasaad together in your party.

steps.text: Speak to @npc{Dorn} inside the Friendly Arm Inn. Recruit him after his encounter while traveling toward the Nashkel Mines.
Recruit @npc{Neera} in Beregost and @npc{Rasaad} in Nashkel. Keep all three in the party together.

achievements.description: Recruit Baeloth the Entertainer.
achievements.summary: Recruit Baeloth the Entertainer.

steps.text: With at least @mechanic{10,000 XP} on your main character, approach the ruined tower in southern @loc{Larswood}. After Baeloth’s scene, speak to him and invite him into your party.

achievements.description: Speak to all the Candlekeep tutors and learn what they have to teach you.
achievements.summary: Learn from all 14 Candlekeep tutors during the prologue.

steps.text: Before leaving Candlekeep with Gorion, save and speak to every green-robed @npc{Tutor}: 12 outside and 2 inside the inn. Work through each tutor’s dialogue options. Reload the save if you leave before finishing.

achievements.description: Kill Tamoko.
achievements.summary: Kill Tamoko.

steps.text: In Chapter 7, save before approaching @npc{Tamoko} near Sorcerous Sundries in eastern Baldur’s Gate. Attack and kill her. Reload afterward to pursue her peaceful outcome.

achievements.description: Persuade Tamoko to abandon her fight against you.
achievements.summary: Persuade Tamoko to abandon her fight against you.

steps.text: In Chapter 7, save before meeting @npc{Tamoko} near Sorcerous Sundries. Accept her request, meet her outside the Flaming Fist headquarters, then kill @enemy{Cythandria} on the Iron Throne’s top floor.

Reach @mechanic{15 or more reputation} and raise your speaker’s Charisma. Save before approaching Tamoko in the @loc{Undercity}. Choose dialogue options @mechanic{1, 3, 2}. Reload if she turns hostile.

achievements.description: Defeat the demon Aec’Letec.
achievements.summary: Defeat the demon Aec’Letec.

steps.text: Take @item{Soultaker} from the Demon Knight’s corpse at the bottom of Durlag’s Tower. Return to @loc{Ulgoth’s Beard} and deal with the cultists who intercept you.
After the cultists take Soultaker, speak to @npc{Hurgan Stoneblade} again inside Ulgoth’s Beard inn. Enter the cult’s @loc{storehouse} and defeat the cultists and @enemy{Aec’Letec}.

achievements.description: Defeat Korlasz and resolve her surrender.
achievements.summary: Defeat Korlasz and resolve her surrender.

steps.text: In the @loc{Korlasz Family Crypt}, defeat @enemy{Korlasz}, then kill her or have her imprisoned.

achievements.description: Depart Baldur’s Gate for Dragonspear Castle.
achievements.summary: Depart Baldur’s Gate for Dragonspear Castle.

steps.text: After resolving Korlasz’s threat and the preparations in Baldur’s Gate, leave the city with the expedition.

achievements.description: Witness the vision of Bhaal at Boareskyr Bridge.
achievements.summary: Witness the vision of Bhaal at Boareskyr Bridge.

steps.text: After resolving the Bridgefort siege and stopping the bridge’s destruction, cross @loc{Boareskyr Bridge} to trigger the vision.

achievements.description: Obtain the wardstone from the Temple of Cyric.
achievements.summary: Obtain the wardstone from the Temple of Cyric.

steps.text: Explore the @loc{Temple of Cyric} in the Forest of Wyrms and obtain @item{the wardstone} from @npc{Akanna}.

achievements.description: Prevent the crusaders from destroying Boareskyr Bridge.
achievements.summary: Prevent the crusaders from destroying Boareskyr Bridge.

steps.text: After the Bridgefort siege, stop the crusaders attempting to destroy @loc{Boareskyr Bridge}.

achievements.description: Enter the Underground River caverns beneath Dragonspear Castle.
achievements.summary: Enter the Underground River caverns beneath Dragonspear Castle.

steps.text: Enter the cave at the @loc{Underground River Entrance}.

achievements.description: Force Hephernaan to flee from Dragonspear Castle’s basement.
achievements.summary: Force Hephernaan to flee from Dragonspear Castle’s basement.

steps.text: Save before entering @loc{Dragonspear Castle Basement}. Go straight to @npc{Hephernaan’s chambers} and fight him until he teleports away.
Reload your entry save if Hephernaan leaves before the fight. Confront him before returning to the Coalition Camp.

achievements.description: Repel the crusader assault on the Coalition Camp.
achievements.summary: Repel the crusader assault on the Coalition Camp.

steps.text: When the @loc{Coalition Camp} is attacked, select reinforcements for each wave and defeat the attacking crusaders.

achievements.description: Kill Belhifet.
achievements.summary: Kill Belhifet.

steps.text: At the top of @loc{Avernus Tower}, defeat @enemy{Belhifet}.

achievements.description: Finish Siege of Dragonspear and witness the ambush outside Baldur’s Gate.
achievements.summary: Finish Siege of Dragonspear and witness the ambush outside Baldur’s Gate.

steps.text: Complete the events following Belhifet’s defeat and watch the final ambush outside @loc{Baldur’s Gate}.

achievements.description: Help Ammon in the Korlasz family tomb.
achievements.summary: Help Ammon prepare her potion and sign her Candlekeep letter.

steps.text: Speak to @npc{Ammon} on the upper level of the Korlasz Family Crypt and agree to help. Keep a save before leaving the tomb.
From the lower level, climb the rope into the otherwise inaccessible upper-level room west of Porios. Search the sarcophagi for @item{Cobalt Moss}.
Bring the moss to Ammon, tell her your story and sign her letter before leaving the crypt.

achievements.description: Discover a secret hidden away in the Korlasz family tomb.
achievements.summary: Recover the Page from Sarevok’s Notes in the Korlasz Family Crypt’s hidden chamber.

steps.text: Keep a save before leaving the Korlasz Family Crypt. On the lower level, take the unlit torch from the wall with two torches opposite a wall with three.
Light the torch at the purple brazier in the previous room. Return the lit torch to its wall container to open the passage.
Enter the chamber and take @item{Page from Sarevok’s Notes} from the table before leaving the crypt.

achievements.description: Enter the hidden treasure chamber in the Temple of Cyric.
achievements.summary: Enter the hidden treasure chamber in the Temple of Cyric.

steps.text: In the southeastern hallway of the @loc{Temple of Cyric}, press the wall masks in the order @mechanic{3, 1, 4}. Enter the newly opened room.

achievements.description: Summon three creatures to the Prime Material Plane using the Spectacles of Spectacle.
achievements.summary: Pull three creatures onto the Prime Material Plane with the Spectacles of Spectacle.

steps.text: The spectacles have only three charges; save before using a charge if choosing creatures other than the listed three.
In Baldur’s Gate’s @loc{Elfsong Tavern}, speak to @npc{Zaviak} and accept the @item{Spectacles of Spectacle}. Keep their three charges for the following creatures.
Equip the spectacles and use their quick-slot ability near @npc{Nazramu} in the southeast of the Coalition Camp.
Summon @npc{Vidyadhar} in the northeastern Underground River cave with the sahuagin, then @npc{Zhadroth} on the northeastern part of Kanaglym’s circular platform.

achievements.description: Kill the green dragon Morentherene.
achievements.summary: Kill the green dragon Morentherene.

steps.text: Enter the @loc{Wyrm Cave} in the Forest of Wyrms and attack the sleeping @enemy{Morentherene}. Kill the dragon.

achievements.description: Convince Teleria to sell her golem.
achievements.summary: Convince Teleria to sell her golem.

steps.text: Speak to @npc{Herod} near the burnt inn at @loc{Coast Way Crossing} about the missing people. Save before confronting @npc{Teleria} a short distance south of him.
Compliment Teleria and her artwork, then offer to buy the golem for @mechanic{1,000 gold}, or 800 with high Charisma. Reload if she becomes hostile.

achievements.description: Neutralize the spellstone threatening Bridgefort.
achievements.summary: Neutralize the spellstone threatening Bridgefort.

steps.text: Speak to @npc{Wynan Hess} in Bridgefort to trigger the spellstone attack. Keep a save before resolving the siege.
Search Vichand’s wagon in the crusader camp for @item{Arcane Scroll of Impactful Doom}. Bring the scroll to Wynan Hess to neutralize the spellstone before the siege ends.

achievements.displayName: Not The Battle We Came For
achievements.description: Arrange Bridgefort’s peaceful surrender to the crusade.
achievements.summary: Arrange Bridgefort’s peaceful surrender to the crusade.

steps.text: Save before resolving the @loc{Bridgefort} siege. Tell @npc{Khalid} to surrender and finish the conversation with the Barghest. Reload the save to take another siege outcome.

achievements.description: Drive the crusaders back across Boareskyr Bridge.
achievements.summary: Drive the crusaders back across Boareskyr Bridge.

steps.text: Save before resolving the @loc{Bridgefort} siege. Attack the crusader camp and defeat the crusaders until they retreat across Boareskyr Bridge. Reload the save to surrender the fort for another outcome.

achievements.description: Open Bridgefort’s drawbridge to let the crusaders inside.
achievements.summary: Open Bridgefort’s drawbridge to let the crusaders inside.

steps.text: Save before resolving the @loc{Bridgefort} siege. Pickpocket @npc{Mari} for the drawbridge key, then lower the drawbridge yourself. Finish the Barghest’s conversation and reload the save to take another siege outcome.

achievements.description: Deliver five former companions’ amulets to Coldhearth.
achievements.summary: Deliver five former companions’ amulets to Coldhearth.

steps.text: In the @loc{Repository of Undeath}, agree to help @npc{Coldhearth}. Save before attacking any dwarves.

Kill the dwarven clerics upstairs and collect their amulets, along with the amulets found on a zombie and in the southern corridor near the Umber Hulks. Deliver @mechanic{five dwarven amulets} to Coldhearth.
Do not speak to Coldhearth again until you have five amulets. Reload your save afterward to destroy him and keep the dwarves alive.

achievements.description: Destroy Coldhearth and his phylactery.
achievements.summary: Destroy Coldhearth and his phylactery.

steps.text: At the @loc{Dwarven Dig Site}, speak to the dwarven clerics and explore the Repository of Undeath. Tell @npc{Deepvein} that Coldhearth became a lich to receive @item{The Secret Revealed}.
Save before fighting @enemy{Coldhearth}. Defeat him and take his key. Open the secret door northeast of him and search the @mechanic{second torch from the left} for his phylactery.

Within @mechanic{one minute}, take the phylactery to the western @loc{Elemental Plane of Fire} portal and use the center of the magic circle. If Coldhearth returns, reload the fight save. Report back to the dwarven clerics afterward.

achievements.description: Kill the mind flayer Darskhelin.
achievements.summary: Kill the mind flayer Darskhelin.

steps.text: Explore beyond Akanna’s wardstone in the @loc{Temple of Cyric}. Defeat @enemy{Darskhelin} in the reliquary.

achievements.description: Poison the crusade’s supplies in Dragonspear Castle.
achievements.summary: Poison the crusade’s supplies in Dragonspear Castle.

steps.text: Accept @npc{Torsin de Lancie’s} sabotage assignment at the Coalition Camp and take his poison.

In @loc{Dragonspear Castle Basement}, save before touching the water cask northwest of the entrance. Interact with the cask twice to poison the supply. Reload afterward to keep poisoning out of your trial record.

achievements.description: Recruit Caelar Argent against Belhifet.
achievements.summary: Recruit Caelar Argent against Belhifet.

steps.text: Save while riding the chain lift to the top of @loc{Avernus Tower}, before reaching the summit.
During the confrontation, blame @npc{Hephernaan} and treat @npc{Caelar Argent} sympathetically. Ask Caelar to join you against Belhifet. Reload the lift save if she becomes his blackguard.

achievements.description: Leave Caelar Argent guarding the portal after defeating Belhifet.
achievements.summary: Leave Caelar Argent guarding the portal after defeating Belhifet.

steps.text: Save on the chain lift before reaching Belhifet. Accuse Hephernaan rather than attacking Caelar’s pride, then persuade Caelar to fight beside you.
Defeat Belhifet with Caelar alive and return through the portal. Reload the lift save to pursue the outcome where Aun stays behind.

achievements.description: Leave Aun Argent guarding the portal after killing Caelar and Belhifet.
achievements.summary: Leave Aun Argent guarding the portal after killing Caelar and Belhifet.

steps.text: Save on the chain lift before reaching Belhifet. Provoke Caelar with “You have been serving him already…” so she becomes Belhifet’s blackguard.
Kill Caelar and Belhifet, free Aun, and return through the portal. Reload the lift save for Caelar’s alternative ending.

achievements.description: Defeat the elite crusader Ashatiel in a one on one battle.
achievements.summary: Defeat Ashatiel in a duel without help from companions.

steps.text: Keep a save before Ashatiel challenges you during the Dragonspear Castle assault. Accept her duel and defeat her without any companion intervening.
Reload that save and refuse the duel if you still need to defeat the bonus enemies; winning the duel makes Delgar Munsch flee.

achievements.description: Reunite the ghosts of Halatathlaer and Daeros Dragonspear.
achievements.summary: Reunite the ghosts of Halatathlaer and Daeros Dragonspear.

guide.context: Keep a save before leaving the chapter. Advancing the story can close this area; reload that save if you leave before finishing.

steps.text: In Kanaglym, speak to the ghost dragon Halatathlaer and defeat Kherrium’s necromancers to free the dragon.
In Dragonspear Castle’s basement, speak to Daeros’s ghost in the side room off Hephernaan’s chambers and release him.

achievements.description: Kill the elite crusaders behind Dragonspear Castle.
achievements.summary: Kill the elite crusaders behind Dragonspear Castle.

steps.text: During the castle assault, go to the northwestern wall and defeat every elite crusader guarding the rear. You can do this even after accepting Ashatiel’s duel.

achievements.description: Defeat Kherrium and the necromancers in Kanaglym.
achievements.summary: Defeat Kherrium and the necromancers in Kanaglym.

guide.context: Keep a save before leaving the chapter. Advancing the story can close this area; reload that save if you leave before finishing.

steps.text: Enter Kanaglym from the southwestern Underground River passage. Defeat Kherrium and his necromancers in the southern part of Kanaglym.

achievements.description: Present evidence of the crusade's crimes to Julann.
achievements.summary: Show Julann evidence of the crusade’s crimes.

steps.text: Take Hephernaan’s Ritual Notes from the chest in Kanaglym. Bring Minsc and Dynaheir to Julann at the Underground River Entrance.

Save before speaking to Julann, then present the notes. If you also need the bonus enemies at Dragonspear, reload and respond with “Dynaheir agrees with my accounting of the ritual” so Julann and Rigah leave for the crusade.

achievements.description: Find the traitor within the coalition camp.
achievements.summary: Expose Malden Col as the coalition camp’s traitor.

steps.text: After meeting the camp commanders, speak to Safana at the Coalition Camp to start The Traitor.

Save before making an accusation. Ask Mizhena, Simonetta or Belegarm about the thefts, then confront Malden Col in the northwest. Accusing Helvdar instead loses the correct outcome; reload your save if necessary.

achievements.description: Perform a task worthy of the Terrible Trivium.
achievements.summary: Complete both of Ladle’s sack-moving jobs.

guide.context: Confronting Hephernaan turns the Underground River hostile. Save before entering his chambers and reload that save if Ladle becomes unavailable.

steps.text: Before confronting Hephernaan, ask Ladle in the Underground River for work and move every heavy sack to the crate he requests.
Report to Ladle and request another job. Move every sack back into the original crate.

achievements.description: Convince Duke Belt that you did not murder Skie.
achievements.summary: Convince Duke Belt that you did not murder Skie.

steps.text: Before the trial, build at least three defenses: tell Madele to make amends, leave the crusade’s supplies unpoisoned, cure Dosia’s patients, keep a high reputation, or play a paladin. Never stake a companion’s soul with Thrix, even on a winning answer.
To cure the patients, take bark from the Strange Tree in Bloodbark Grove to Dosia at the Coalition Camp.

Keep the Chapter 13 starting autosave. During the trial, present at least three good deeds and avoid admitting guilt. The unlock follows the trial when you return to prison. Reload the chapter save to pursue Corwin’s sewer outcome.

achievements.description: Persuade Rigah to turn against Julann.
achievements.summary: Persuade Rigah to turn against Julann.

steps.text: Bring Minsc, Dynaheir and Hephernaan’s Ritual Notes from Kanaglym to the Underground River Entrance. Save before discussing the notes with Julann.
Speak to Rigah first and undermine his trust in Julann. Dialogue choices 2,2,2,1,2,1 lead to the journal message that your conversation depressed him.
Show Julann the notes. When she dismisses them, tell Rigah his witch is corrupt, then kill Julann. Reload your earlier save if you need Julann and Rigah alive for the castle’s bonus enemies.

achievements.displayName: In the Name of the Father
achievements.description: Order Madele to kill in Bhaal’s name.
achievements.summary: Order Madele to kill in Bhaal’s name.

steps.text: Find the jail key in the Temple of Cyric and save before freeing Madele. Tell her to murder for Bhaal. Reload before Madele’s conversation to choose her amends outcome instead.

achievements.description: Tell Madele to make amends for her killings.
achievements.summary: Tell Madele to make amends for her killings.

steps.text: Find the jail key in the Temple of Cyric and save before freeing Madele. Order her to make amends. Reload that save if you chose to have her kill in Bhaal’s name.

achievements.description: Fail to impress the ancient menhirs with your singing ability.
achievements.summary: Fail the ancient menhirs’ singing test and answer their riddle incorrectly.

steps.text: At Coast Way Crossing, use a character with Charisma below 16 who was in the party both on arrival and when you first spoke to Prin. Save before interacting with the menhirs.
Sing to the six menhirs and give a wrong answer when the riddle appears. Finish the encounter with Crommus. Reload and answer the riddle correctly for Riddlemaster.

achievements.description: Side with Tsolak the vampire.
achievements.summary: Support Tsolak against the vampire hunters.

steps.text: Save before approaching Isabella and Ikros in Coast Way Forest at night. Support Tsolak and fight the hunters; a paladin can respond with “A better plan is to kill you, Isabella”. Keep playing until Tsolak’s messenger arrives in Chapter 9 if the unlock has not appeared. Reload the earlier save for the hunters’ alternative outcome.

achievements.description: Defeat the four burglars at Sorcerous Sundries without companions.
achievements.summary: Return Halbazzer’s potions case after defeating the four Sorcerous Sundries burglars alone.

steps.text: In Chapter 7, agree to help Halbazzer at Sorcerous Sundries. Save, then remove every companion from the party before going upstairs.
Kill the four burglars alone and bring Halbazzer the potions case he requested. Reload the save if you want to restore your previous party.

achievements.description: Save all the missing refugees in the Coast Way forest.
achievements.summary: Restore all five petrified refugees at Coast Way Crossing.

guide.context: Keep a save before leaving the chapter. Advancing the story can close this area; reload that save if you leave before finishing.

steps.text: Buy five @item{Stone to Flesh} scrolls from Belegarm. Ask Herod by the burned inn about the missing people, then follow Teleria to the northwestern clearing and use one scroll on each of the five statues.

achievements.description: Find all of Takos's missing heirlooms.
achievements.summary: Return Takos’s three missing heirlooms.

steps.text: Accept Halfling Treasures from Takos at Coast Way Crossing. Recover the mirror and cloak from the burned inn.
In Coast Way Forest, get the shield Suncatcher from Isabella by pickpocketing her, helping her, or looting her after siding with Tsolak.
Save before returning to Takos. Give him every heirloom; keeping one prevents the achievement, so reload that save if needed.

achievements.description: Deal with an angry water elemental.
achievements.summary: Resolve the encounter with the angry water elemental at Boareskyr Bridge.

steps.text: After crossing Boareskyr Bridge, put a weapon into the well immediately north of the bridge and deal with the water elemental that appears.

achievements.description: Train all of Vigilant Halasan's recruits properly.
achievements.summary: Train all six of Vigilant Halasan’s recruits properly.

steps.text: Save before starting Troop Train at the Coalition Camp. The recruits are Hester, Morlis, Clovista, Danine, Taield and Garrold.

Use companions’ training options for at least three recruits: Edwin or Dynaheir for Garrold; Jaheira for Taield; Safana for Danine; M’Khiin or Glint for Clovista; Dorn for Morlis; M’Khiin or Viconia for Hester.
Train the remaining recruits and report to Halasan. Reload the training save if he is not satisfied.

achievements.description: Help Jamven and Chorster defeat Ferrusk.
achievements.summary: Help Jamven and Chorster defeat Ferrusk.

steps.text: At the northwestern oak at the Underground River Entrance, free Jamven and Chorster from the vines with Dispel Magic or by attacking the vines. Accept their request.
At the southeastern Underground River cave, first accept Ferrusk’s request to kill Jamven and Chorster. Then kill Ferrusk and put the Enchanted Seed into the Corrupted Oak.
Save before reporting back to Jamven and Chorster. Tell them you killed Ferrusk for them. Reload if you instead choose Ferrusk’s side and kill the surface druids.

achievements.description: Side with Ferrusk against Jamven and Chorster.
achievements.summary: Side with Ferrusk against Jamven and Chorster.

steps.text: In the southeastern Underground River cave, accept Ferrusk’s request to kill Jamven and Chorster.

Save before confronting the two druids at the northwestern oak outside. Tell them Ferrusk convinced you to take their lives, then kill them. Return to Ferrusk if he is alive. Reload the confrontation save for the surface druids’ outcome.

achievements.description: Track down all of Glint's family members.
achievements.summary: Introduce Glint to Hoach, Pritchard and Rhonda.

steps.text: With Glint in the party, speak to Hoach Randymonk in Bridgefort. At the Coalition Camp, save before helping Damius and Sempek deal with Pritchard, then meet Pritchard with Glint before that task makes Pritchard leave. Reload the camp save if Pritchard has already departed.
Save before meeting Rhonda in the northwestern Warrens beneath Dragonspear. Speak to her with Glint present; reload if you met her without Glint.

achievements.description: Get the strange voice out of Neera's head.
achievements.summary: Remove the voice troubling Neera with her five requested ingredients.

guide.context: Keep a save before leaving the chapter. Advancing the story can close this area; reload that save if you leave before finishing.

steps.text: Speak to Neera in Bridgefort. Get a Potion of Perception from a merchant and a Giant Spider Leg from the Forest of Wyrms spider cave.
Buy or steal the Planetar Feather from the chest in the Boareskyr Bridge crusader camp before resolving the siege.
Pick Belladonna from the bush near the center of Bloodbark Grove. In Chapter 10, help Wilhelmina set up shop at the Coalition Camp and obtain her Turnip Juice.
Return the five ingredients to Neera.

achievements.description: Aid Khalid with his romantic request.
achievements.summary: Help Khalid finish his anniversary gift for Jaheira.

guide.context: Keep a save before leaving the chapter. Advancing the story can close this area; reload that save if you leave before finishing.

steps.text: After recruiting Khalid at Boareskyr Bridge, ask why he seems anxious. Give him Spider Web from the Forest of Wyrms spider cave or Dead Man’s Pass.
Let his quest advance, then give him an Aquamarine Gem when he asks. You can pickpocket an Aquamarine Gem from Waizahb at the Coalition Camp.

achievements.description: Help M'Khiin find her path.
achievements.summary: Help M’Khiin decide her future in Kanaglym.

guide.context: Keep a save before leaving the chapter. Advancing the story can close this area; reload that save if you leave before finishing.

steps.text: With M’Khiin in your party, search the rubble on Kanaglym’s eastern side. Finish her conversation about her path; any of the offered paths works.

achievements.description: Convince Corwin that you did not murder Skie.
achievements.summary: Convince Corwin that you did not murder Skie.

steps.text: Keep the Chapter 13 starting autosave before your trial. Do not defend yourself in court, then escape prison through the sewers.
Save before the sewer confrontation with Corwin and Bence. Surrender to Corwin and do not mention Rohma. Reload if your answers make Corwin refuse to believe you.

achievements.description: Have Baeloth, Viconia, M'Khiin, Dorn, and Edwin in the same party.
achievements.summary: Have Baeloth, Viconia, M’Khiin, Dorn and Edwin together in your party.

guide.context: Keep a save before leaving the chapter. Advancing the story can close this area; reload that save if you leave before finishing.

steps.text: Recruit Viconia while leaving Baldur’s Gate. At Coast Way Crossing, find Edwin near the Flaming Fist camp and Baeloth with M’Khiin north of camp.
In Chapter 9, free Dorn from the crusader camp at Boareskyr Bridge and put Baeloth, Viconia, M’Khiin, Dorn and Edwin in the party together.

achievements.description: Have Corwin, Glint, M'Khiin, and Voghiln in the same party.
achievements.summary: Have Corwin, Glint, M’Khiin and Voghiln together in your party.

guide.context: Keep a save before leaving the chapter. Advancing the story can close this area; reload that save if you leave before finishing.

steps.text: Recruit Corwin and Glint at Coast Way Crossing’s Flaming Fist camp and M’Khiin north of camp. In Chapter 9, recruit Voghiln from the northern road in Troll Claw Woods and keep all four in the party together.

achievements.description: Lose a companion’s soul to Thrix’s riddle wager.
achievements.summary: Lose a companion’s soul to Thrix’s riddle wager.

steps.text: After Thrix’s demon fight on the Avernus Bridge, save before his riddle. Wager a companion’s soul and answer incorrectly; “Murder” is the correct answer, so choose something else. Reload afterward to solve the riddle and avoid harming your later defense at the trial.

achievements.description: Reunite with old friends.
achievements.summary: Keep Safana, Khalid, Jaheira, Minsc and Dynaheir in the same party.

steps.text: Before clearing Nashkel Mines at the end of Chapter 2, save and visit the Friendly Arm Inn. Recruit Jaheira and Khalid there. Reload this earlier save if you cleared the mines before meeting them and they disappeared.

Recruit Minsc in Nashkel, rescue Dynaheir at the Gnoll Stronghold, and recruit Safana in the Lighthouse area. Keep Safana, Khalid, Jaheira, Minsc and Dynaheir together in your party. Retain a save before each recruitment decision so you can undo a refusal or Dynaheir’s death.

achievements.description: Explore all unique encounters.
achievements.summary: Visit the four unique travel encounters in Siege of Dragonspear.

steps.text: Save before leaving each chapter. In Chapter 8, travel from Coast Way Forest back to Coast Way Crossing for the orcs-versus-trolls encounter.
In Chapter 9, travel from Troll Claw Woods to Forest of Wyrms for the goblin ambush, then leave Forest of Wyrms for the young green dragon and hill giants.
In Chapter 10, leave the Coalition Camp for the canyon ambush involving the Shadowy Figure. If an earlier encounter was skipped, reload the corresponding chapter save before advancing.

achievements.description: Have a dragonscale shield or armor forged.
achievements.summary: Have a dragonscale shield or armor forged.

guide.context: Save before resolving the Bridgefort siege. Reload that save if Jegg is no longer available to craft the item.

steps.text: Take Morentherene’s scales after killing the green dragon in the Forest of Wyrms. Before resolving Bridgefort’s siege, give the scales to Jegg in Bridgefort and request a shield or armor.

achievements.description: Have a weapon forged from Voidstone Shards.
achievements.summary: Have a weapon forged from Voidstone Shards.

guide.context: Save before resolving the Bridgefort siege. Reload that save if Jegg is no longer available to craft the item.

steps.text: After neutralizing Bridgefort’s spellstone, examine the stone and take the Voidstone Shards. Before resolving the siege, ask Jegg in Bridgefort to forge a weapon from the shards.

achievements.description: Use infravision to navigate an area of darkness.
achievements.summary: Find a hidden object in darkness using infravision.

guide.context: Keep a save before leaving the chapter. Advancing the story can close this area; reload that save if you leave before finishing.

steps.text: In Troll Claw Woods’ western Troll Cave, take the Tinderbox from the main cave. Send a character with infravision through the secret door into the dark chamber and locate the unlit torch. Cast Infravision if your chosen character lacks the ability.

achievements.description: Accept Ophyllis’s gold bust of your character.
achievements.summary: Accept Ophyllis’s gold bust of your character.

steps.text: In Chapter 7, speak to Ophyllis in the Ducal Palace basement to start My Missing Fortune. Keep a save before leaving Baldur’s Gate. In Chapter 8, resolve the Coast Way Crossing bridge conflict, return to camp and accept Ophyllis’s gold bust. Reload the Chapter 7 save if you never started his quest.

achievements.description: Kill Nüber three times in Dead Man’s Pass.
achievements.summary: Kill Nüber three times in Dead Man’s Pass.

steps.text: Save before speaking to Nüber in southern Dead Man’s Pass. Kill him three times rather than letting him finish talking and leave; reload if he has already gone home.

achievements.displayName: I'm A Wizard and That Looks...
achievements.description: Kill the imprisoned crusaders with the Temple of Cyric’s lever.
achievements.summary: Kill the imprisoned crusaders with the Temple of Cyric’s lever.

steps.text: Save beside the three caged crusaders near the Temple of Cyric entrance. Pull the lever to the left of their cages. Reload afterward if you want to undo the killings; paladins and rangers become Fallen.

achievements.description: Recruit all the bonus allies possible for the final battle.
achievements.summary: Recruit the golem, Murs and Slug for the Dragonspear assault.

steps.text: In Chapter 8, compliment Teleria’s golem at Coast Way Crossing and buy the golem for 1,000 gold, or 800 with high Charisma. Save before dealing with Teleria; killing her blocks the purchase.

At the Underground River Entrance, fight as Murs’s champion alone and without magic. Agree to find Slug. Free him from the cage right of the Warrens entrance, then return to Murs and ask the ogres to join your forces.

Keep a save before the Chapter 11 assault. If you placed the Bwoosh barrel, choose “Could’ve been better…” when de Lancie questions you and use the weak side wall rather than the main entrance. Reload the assault save if the allies do not appear.

achievements.description: Fight all the bonus enemies possible at the final battle.
achievements.summary: Defeat Delgar Munsch, Julann, Rigah and Strunk during the Dragonspear assault.

steps.text: In Chapter 9, surrender Bridgefort peacefully so Delgar Munsch survives to fight at Dragonspear. Save before resolving the siege.

At the Underground River Entrance, bring Minsc, Dynaheir and Hephernaan’s Ritual Notes to Julann. Respond with “Dynaheir agrees with my accounting of the ritual” so she and Rigah leave for the crusade. Leave Strunk’s magic alone in the Underground River and avoid killing him when the area turns hostile.
Save before the castle assault. Refuse Ashatiel’s duel and defeat Delgar Munsch, Julann, Rigah and Strunk. Reload the duel save if you accepted her challenge and caused Munsch to flee.

achievements.description: Win the coalition camp defense after choosing unsuitable troops for each of the first three waves.
achievements.summary: Win the coalition camp defense after choosing unsuitable troops for each of the first three waves.

steps.text: Save after Andrus explains the attack. Send Auziel’s rogues against the trolls, Garrus’s archers against the mages, and Stysich’s wizard slayers against the third wave.
Win those fights and defeat Grimgor in the fourth wave. Reload the pre-attack save if you chose a different set of units.

achievements.description: Reveal your identity to the crusaders at Boareskyr Bridge.
achievements.summary: Reveal your identity to the crusaders at Boareskyr Bridge.

steps.text: Save before speaking to Oloneiros in the Boareskyr Bridge crusader camp. Reveal who you are and survive until the achievement appears. Reload to restore a peaceful camp if you still need to surrender Bridgefort or finish camp tasks.

achievements.description: Solve the menhir’s, Vidyadhar’s and Thrix’s riddles correctly.
achievements.summary: Solve the menhir’s, Vidyadhar’s and Thrix’s riddles correctly.

steps.text: Save before arriving at Coast Way Crossing with a singer below 16 Charisma. Keep that character in the party on arrival and when you first speak to Prin; a different roster prevents the singer from using the menhirs, so reload the earlier save if needed. Sing at the menhir beside the statues and answer “The wind blowing in a tree next to a river.”

Keep one charge of the Spectacles of Spectacle for Vidyadhar. In Chapter 10, wear the spectacles in the northeastern Underground River cave with the two sahuagin, summon Vidyadhar through the quick-slot ability, and answer “Bees”.

In Chapter 12, save before Thrix’s wager at the Avernus Bridge and answer “Murder”. Wager your own soul if you want to preserve your trial defense; reload if you answered incorrectly or bet a companion’s soul.
